description: Reference values of the VectorDB numeric core: RN_53 of exact rationals and of square roots, and the outcome of one query and one record for each metric. Elements are integers, rationals p/q, f64:<bits> or bool:<b>. A delivered value is the hex bits of a binary64 value (+0 for zero), ValueOutOfRange, or null when the score is undefined. within is decided with real algebraic numbers for cosine and euclidean.
